The Chairman of the Public Service Commission (PSC) has officially resigned from his post.

headline: Senior lawyer Tawfique Nawaz dies at 79 in Dhaka
summary: He was the husband of former Awami League minister Dipu Moni, who is currently in custody in Munshiganj District Jail.
details: Tawfique Nawaz, a senior advocate of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh and husband of former minister Dipu Moni, passed away on Tuesday night at Continental Hospital in Dhaka.
He died at 10:27 pm at the age of 79, according to hospital officials.
An Oxbridge-educated lawyer, Nawaz headed the law firm Juris Counsel and served as a member of the Board of Trustees of Transparency International Bangladesh.

He was a member of the Supreme Court Bar Association and the International Law Association, and served as director of the Bangladesh Institute of Law and International Affairs (BILIA) from 1979 to 1982.
Beyond his professional legal career, Nawaz was also a practitioner of classical music.
Nawaz had suffered a stroke in 2019, and as recently as May 27 this year, he was taken to court in a wheelchair to meet his wife, who is currently held in Munshiganj District Jail.
Dipu Moni is an accused in several cases filed over incidents during the July Uprising.
caption:
Senior Supreme Court lawyer Tawfique Nawaz, husband of former minister Dipu Moni, has passed away at 79.

Tawfique Nawaz, a senior advocate of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh and husband of former minister Dipu Moni, passed away on Tuesday night at Continental Hospital in Dhaka.

He died at 10:27 pm at the age of 79, according to hospital officials.

An Oxbridge-educated lawyer, Nawaz headed the law firm Juris Counsel and served as a member of the Board of Trustees of Transparency International Bangladesh.

He was a member of the Supreme Court Bar Association and the International Law Association, and served as director of the Bangladesh Institute of Law and International Affairs (BILIA) from 1979 to 1982.

Beyond his professional legal career, Nawaz was also a practitioner of classical music.

Nawaz had suffered a stroke in 2019, and as recently as May 27 this year, he was taken to court in a wheelchair to meet his wife, who is currently held in Munshiganj District Jail.

Dipu Moni is an accused in several cases filed over incidents during the July Uprising.
